content.user_title: Containerize Apps for Docker and Kubernetes
content.value_statement: Container setup often fails because runtime, networking, and security details are scattered. This skill helps Claude, Codex, and Claude Code create Docker, Compose, and Helm guidance from one workflow.
actual_capabilities: Drafts multi-stage Dockerfile patterns for Python FastAPI and Next.js applications.
Creates Docker Compose service layouts with build args, environment variables, ports, dependencies, and health checks.
Outlines Helm chart structure, values files, and common install or upgrade commands.
Documents container networking fixes for browser URLs, service names, health checks, and startup order.
Adds production security guidance for hardened images, distroless images, Trivy scans, SBOMs, and BuildKit secrets.
limitations: Generated templates still need review against the application repository and deployment environment.
The skill does not deploy workloads or verify Kubernetes cluster access by itself.
Image tags, tool versions, and cloud policies may need updates for each organization.
It does not replace threat modeling, compliance review, or production incident procedures.

use_cases.title: Containerize a web API
use_cases.description: Create a Dockerfile plan for a FastAPI service with non-root execution, exposed ports, and dependency installation.

use_cases.title: Prepare local service orchestration
use_cases.description: Design a Docker Compose setup for web, API, and database services with internal URLs and health checks.

use_cases.title: Package a Kubernetes release
use_cases.description: Draft Helm chart files, values, resource limits, and deployment notes for a containerized application.

prompt_templates.title: Create a basic Dockerfile
prompt_templates.prompt: Containerize this application with a production Dockerfile. Identify the runtime, dependency files, ports, and required environment variables first.

prompt_templates.title: Build Docker Compose services
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a Docker Compose plan for this web and API project. Include service names, health checks, startup order, and browser versus server URLs.

prompt_templates.title: Add production security checks
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this container setup for production. Add hardened image options, Trivy scanning, SBOM generation, non-root users, and secret handling guidance.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a Helm deployment
prompt_templates.prompt: Package this app as a Helm chart. Include values for images, replicas, services, ingress, resources, secrets, and safe upgrade commands.

output_examples.input: Containerize a FastAPI service that listens on port 8000.
output_examples.output: A Dockerfile plan with build and runtime stages, dependency installation, a non-root user, an exposed port, and a Uvicorn start command.

output_examples.input: Create local containers for a Next.js frontend and API backend.
output_examples.output: A Compose plan that separates browser URLs from service URLs, adds health checks, and waits for the API before starting dependent services.

output_examples.input: Prepare this image for a production Kubernetes release.
output_examples.output: A release checklist covering hardened base images, vulnerability scanning, SBOM output, BuildKit secrets, resource limits, and Helm values.

best_practices: Run an impact analysis before writing container files, including ports, secrets, CORS, and service dependencies.
Use multi-stage builds, non-root users, health checks, and minimal runtime images for production services.
Keep secrets out of images by using BuildKit mounts, environment injection, and a strict dockerignore file.
anti_patterns: Do not bake database passwords, API keys, or private certificates into Docker images.
Do not use localhost for server-to-server calls inside Docker Compose networks.
Do not deploy generated Helm values without reviewing resource limits, ingress settings, and secret management.

faq.question: What application types does this skill cover?
faq.answer: It includes patterns for FastAPI, Next.js, Docker Compose services, and Helm-based Kubernetes deployments.

faq.question: Can it create production-ready Dockerfiles?
faq.answer: It provides production-oriented templates, but each Dockerfile needs review against the real repository and runtime requirements.

faq.question: Does it run Docker or Kubernetes commands?
faq.answer: No. The skill provides guidance and command examples. The user or agent decides what to execute.

faq.question: How does it handle secrets?
faq.answer: It recommends BuildKit secret mounts, environment injection, and dockerignore entries for sensitive files.

faq.question: Does it support Helm charts?
faq.answer: Yes. It outlines chart structure, values files, templating checks, and install or upgrade workflows.

faq.question: Which AI tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
